6573.html:
6573 daivasaka 'happening in one day' MBh. [divasá-]
    Pa. dēvasika- 'daily', °kaṁ adv. 'every day'; Pk. dēvasia- 'relative to day'; L. dehā̃, ḍehā̃, (Ju.) ḍ̠ehā̃ adv. 'by day, tomorrow', awāṇ. dḕā̃ 'tomorrow'.
    *daivika-, daíviya- see next.

11625.html:
11625 vikāla m. 'twilight, evening' ĀpŚr., °aka- m. lex. [→ Par. wiyār 'night' with r < ḷ IIFL i 298, Yghn. wiora 'night', Yazgh. biyēr 'yesterday', Shgh. biyâr (NTS i 49 < *upa-ayā̆ra-). — kālá-²]
    Pa. vikāla- m. 'evening', °lē 'very late'; Pk. viāla- m. 'evening'; Paš.lauṛ. vyāl f. 'night', ar. viyōl, kuṛ. vel (→ Shum. wyel m. NTS xiii 243), Gaw. yel, hel; Bshk. žāl 'yesterday', Tor. byäl di, Chil. biyāli, Sh. gil. bălā, koh. gur. byālĕ (→ Ḍ. biā́li), pales. byēlä; WPah.khaś. biāl 'early night'; Ku. byāl 'evening', byāle, beliyā 'yesterday', gng. beiⁱ; N. byālo 'delay', adj. 'slow'; A. biyali 'afternoon'; Bi. beālū 'evening meal'; H. bīaṛ f. 'evening' (ṛ?), byālū m. 'evening meal', OG. vyālū n.; M. vīḷ m. 'afternoon, forenoon, day'. — X adyá: WPah.khaś. biālj̈ 'tonight', bhad. ḍḷΛoj̈ (ḍḷ- like Bshk. ž- above < by- or bry- with 'intrusive' r). — Deriv.: Ap. viāliu n. 'evening meal', WPah.cam. biārī (or < *vikālāhāra- ?), bhal. biāī f., H. byārī f.
    *vikālakāla-, *vikālavēlā-, *vikālāhāra-.
    Addenda: vikāla-: WPah.kṭg. bε῀ḷ f. 'evening', kc. byāḷ f., kṭg. (Wkc.) bεḷi f. 'evening, evening meal'; J. byāḷi f. 'supper', byālṭi f. 'evening'; Garh. vyāḷi 'yesterday'.

7576.html:
7576 nūnám 'now' RV. [~ *nūram. — nú]
    Pa. nūnaṁ, °na 'dubitative or asseverative particle', Pk. ṇūṇaṁ, °ṇa; Wg. nū̃ 'today', Paš. nū, Shum. nun, Gmb. nū̃, Gaw. nūn; — Kho. hanún (with Kho. emph. particle ha- ?); — Aw.lakh. restrictive particle -n EA 322; — nū- 'now' in Ash. Kt. nutrī́ 'day before yesterday', Wg. nútriäm, Gaw. nũλī, Sv. nuλia; Ash. nüċyū́ṭ 'three days ago', Wg. nučetúm, Gaw. núċorom; Ash. napṓċeṛẽ 'four days ago'.
    *ā nūnam.
